events.title: DashBreaker Update - Upgrade Tree Rework
events.summary: Hello from the developer of DashBreaker! This update introduces a reworked upgrade tree for the demo. The upgrades you buy now open up your next choices, letting you discover new upgrades and abilities as you grow stronger. Upgrade layouts, prices and prerequisites have also been adjusted. The aim is to make the progression from piercing larger enemies to unlocking abilities that change how you fight feel more natural. Returning players: please visit the upgrade terminal before your next sortie.

events.title: DashBreaker Update - More Freedom to Move
events.summary: Hello from the developer of DashBreaker! This update is about spending less time saving your dashes and more time moving and crashing into targets. The loop of fighting, collecting resources and permanently upgrading your ship continues. More freedom to move Dashing and using your booster no longer consume extra energy. events.title: DashBreaker Renewed — A New Look and a New Way to Play
events.summary: Hello from the developer of DashBreaker! DashBreaker has evolved from arcade action into an active incremental game. This renewal brings a full overhaul of the game's progression and visuals. Reworked gameplay — Hands-on dash action now leads into resource collection and permanent upgrades. Revamped visuals — Ships, enemies, UI and combat effects have all received a fresh look. events.title: DashBreaker Demo Update — Training and Controls Improved
events.summary: Thank you for playing the DashBreaker Demo. This update makes training easier to follow when learning the basics, and improves combat module setup and several parts of combat. Training improvements Reduced training target counts and durations, and eased the attack patterns in the Phase Armor trial. During training, fuel is unlimited, incoming damage is reduced, and HP cannot fall below 1. Your ship automatically repairs itself after a short time without taking damage.
